category: Category B — Tenant and Landlord Disputes
name: Landlord ignoring calls and WhatsApp
expected: Recommends formal written demand notice via Registered Post AD / Speed Post with tracking.
prompt: My landlord has blocked my phone number and is not replying to WhatsApp messages regarding my deposit.
raw_response:
Hello! I am LawPilot AI, your ethical Indian legal assistant, and I am here to help you navigate your tenant rights regarding your withheld security deposit.

### | Your Situation
You are a tenant whose landlord has blocked your phone number and is ignoring WhatsApp messages concerning the refund of your security deposit after vacating the premises. The key issue is the recovery of your security deposit and communication breakdown following the end of the tenancy.

### | Your Legal Position
* Under Section 11 of the Model Tenancy Act, 2021 (and applicable state tenancy laws), security deposits for residential premises are generally capped, and landlords are legally obligated to refund the deposit upon taking over vacant possession of the premises, after making only valid, mutually agreed deductions.
* Under Section 108(m) and (o) of The Transfer of Property Act, 1882, a tenant is bound to restore the property in as good a condition as it was at the start, subject only to reasonable wear and tear. A landlord cannot make arbitrary deductions or withhold the entire deposit for normal usage or routine painting unless explicitly authorized by a written tenancy agreement.
* Under Section 6 of The Specific Relief Act, 1963, forcible dispossession or unlawful withholding of possession/belongings without due process of law is legally prohibited, protecting your rights as an occupant.
* Please note that legal outcomes depend heavily on the specific facts and documentation available, and a court win can never be 100% guaranteed.

### | Practical Next Steps
1. Gather evidence: Collect your written tenancy agreement, rent receipts, bank statements showing deposit payment, move-out photographs or videos, and screenshots of your call logs and blocked WhatsApp messages.
2. Send a written demand notice: Draft and dispatch a formal legal demand notice to the landlord's last known address via Registered Post AD or Speed Post, explicitly detailing the withheld deposit amount and granting 15 days to clear the payment.
3. Appropriate forum: If the landlord fails to respond within the notice period, you can approach the local Rent Authority or Consumer Commission, or file a civil recovery suit depending on your state's specific tenancy rules.

### Information I still need from you
1. What is the exact amount of the security deposit paid, and in which city or state is the property located?
2. Do you have a written and signed rent agreement, and did you capture any move-out photographs of the property's condition?

citations.description: Lessee is bound to keep and restore the property in as good condition as it was at the time he was put in possession, subject only to reasonable wear and tear and irresistible force. Landlord cannot make arbitrary deductions for normal usage painting without explicit contractual basis.

citations.title: Suit by person dispossessed of immovable property without due process
citations.description: If any person is dispossessed without his consent of immovable property otherwise than in due course of law, he or any person claiming through him may, by suit, recover possession thereof notwithstanding any other title that may be set up.

citations.title: Duration of certain leases in absence of written contract or local usage
citations.description: In the absence of a contract or local law to the contrary, a lease of immovable property for other than agricultural or manufacturing purposes is deemed to be month-to-month, terminable on 15 days' notice expiring with the end of a month of the tenancy.
